name: SignatureInfo
description: Represents the information used to create a digital or in-document signature.
example:
Sub GetCertDetails()
Dim objSignatureInfo As SignatureInfo
Dim varDetail As Variant

strDetail = objSignatureInfo.GetCertificateDetail(certdetExpirationDate)

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SignatureInfo object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SignatureInfo object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the SignatureInfo object is read-only. Read-only.

properties.name: SignatureProvider
properties.description: Gets a value identifying an installed signature provider add-in. Read-only.

properties.name: SignatureText
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the signature text used to sign this document. Read/write.

properties.name: SignatureImage
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the image used to sign the document. Read/write.

properties.name: SignatureComment
properties.description: Gets or sets a value containing comments included in a signature packet. Read/write.

properties.name: ContentVerificationResults
properties.description: Gets a value representing the results of the verification of the hashed contents of a signed document. Read-only.

properties.name: CertificateVerificationResults
properties.description: Gets the results from the verification of a digital certificate. Read-only.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the signature was successfully validated following signature verification. Read-only.

properties.name: IsCertificateExpired
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the digital certificate is expired. Read-only.

properties.name: IsCertificateRevoked
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the digital certificate is revoked. Read-only.

properties.name: IsCertificateUntrusted
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the digital certificate used to digitally sign a document comes from a trusted source. Read-only.

methods.name: GetSignatureDetail
methods.description: Displays a specified detail related to a signature.

parameters.name: sigdet
parameters.description: An enumerated value specifying which signature detail to display.

methods.name: GetCertificateDetail
methods.description: Displays a specified detail related to a digital certificate.

parameters.name: certdet
parameters.description: An enumerated value specifying which certificate detail to display.

methods.name: ShowSignatureCertificate
methods.description: Displays the selected or default digital certificate.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the handle to the window that contains the Certificate dialog box.

methods.name: SelectSignatureCertificate
methods.description: Displays a dialog box that allows users to select which signature certificate to use for signing a document.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains a handle to the window containing the certificate selection dialog box.

methods.name: SelectCertificateDetailByThumbprint
methods.description: Displays a dialog box containing information about a digital certificate following verification of the user from a thumbprint.

parameters.name: bstrThumbprint
parameters.description: Contains information about the signer identified by the thumbprint.
